citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7314479

isBasedOn.name: Institutional Requirements for Sovereign Local Agent Runtimes

abstract: Reputation earned in one domain must not transfer silently to another. Domain specificity was the central design commitment of the earliest architecture in this line (Calcaterra, Kaal, and Andrei 2018) and remains the property most often discarded in implementation, because a single number is easier to display than a vector.
